steps.note: Ghost on the duty handset, default branch (no m02 deal): two misses, then the hospital appeal works and the sale is stopped. Re-opening the handset afterwards only offers to put it down.

said: You don't know me. That's rather the point.
Five buyers. One of them wants the hospitals.
If it sells, the release console can kill that share. It only does one.
No. I'd rather not leave on that.
My share stays where it is. A clean exit, for once.
notSaid: Then watch. Five buyers, and not one of them knows you're in the room.
You don't know me. That's rather the point.
